# TARDIS ![](reference/figures/tardis.png)

R package for *TArgeted Raw Data Integration In Spectrometry*

## Installation

Make sure `R` (**version \>= 4.4.0**) is installed on your computer:

<https://cloud.r-project.org/index.html>

For **Windows** users, `Rtools` should be installed as well:

<https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/rtools44/rtools.html>

For **Mac** users, please install Xcode and a GNU Fortran compiler, see:
<https://mac.r-project.org/tools/index.html> For Xcode, you can run this
line in your Mac OS terminal:

    sudo xcode-select --install

For the latest version of `TARDIS`, `BiocManager` **version 3.20** is
required: <https://www.bioconductor.org/install/>

In R, run:

    if (!require("devtools", quietly = TRUE))
        install.packages("devtools")

    if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
        install.packages("BiocManager")

    BiocManager::install("UGent-LIMET/TARDIS",build_vignettes = FALSE,
      dependencies=TRUE)

Since the package contains some example data, connection timeout is
often an issue. You can increase your timeout setting in R using:

    options(timeout = "300")

The number indicates the timeout setting in seconds.

## Usage

Load the package:

    library(TARDIS)

**Read the vignettes** for a tutorial on how to use `TARDIS`

Available online: <https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/index.html>

Or, if you installed with `build_vignettes = TRUE`

    RShowDoc("quick_start",package = "TARDIS")

    RShowDoc("gui_tutorial",package = "TARDIS")

    RShowDoc("case_study",package = "TARDIS")

To launch the GUI in R:

    runTardis()

# Package index

## All functions

- [`checkScans()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/checkScans.md)
  : Check if any samples are missing spectra
- [`createRanges()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/createRanges.md)
  : Create m/z and retention time ranges for target compounds
- [`createTargetList()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/createTargetList.md)
  : Create target list
- [`find_peak_points()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/find_peak_points.md)
  : Simple peak detection algorithm on chromatographic data
- [`find_peak_points_orig()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/find_peak_points_orig.md)
  : Find peak points
- [`integrateSinglePeak()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/integrateSinglePeak.md)
  : Integrate single chromatographic peak in single file
- [`plotDiagnostic()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/plotDiagnostic.md)
  : Diagnostic plots
- [`plotQCs()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/plotQCs.md)
  : Function to make plots of QC samples
- [`plotSamples()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/plotSamples.md)
  : Function to make plots of samples
- [`qscoreCalculator()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/qscoreCalculator.md)
  : qcoreCalculator
- [`renameRawFiles()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/renameRawFiles.md)
  : Rename Thermo .raw files Script to read XCalibur sequence list and
  rename files according to run type (sample, QC, blank, etc...)
- [`runTardis()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/runTardis.md)
  : Run T.A.R.D.I.S.
- [`tardisPeaks()`](https://ugent-limet.github.io/TARDIS/reference/tardisPeaks.md)
  : TARDIS Peak Detection
